name: STOIC2021 training (AWS Open Data)
what: STOIC2021 training set, 2,000 chest CT as MHA on AWS Open Data (s3://stoic2021-training; LICENCE.txt read 2026-09-23), about 240 GB; also inside CADS (gated) and re-packed as AUC23 'Lung CT COVID-19'
level_truth: counted by the census pipeline once fetched
status: planned in the data platform at bf1432f; fetch job in the 2026-10-21 chain
how_to_get: spinesurg-ct-nnunet's slurm/acquisition_fetch.sh s3 --collection stoic2021 --bucket s3://stoic2021-training/data/mha --include '\.mha$', submitted from the harvest's acquisition folder; the check is FETCH_STATUS.json's unresolved_failures at 0, and the 2,000 MHA verified by size.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid aws_stoic2021; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="aws_stoic2021",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
